استصبحن (form X)
# اِسْتَصْبَحْنَ (istaṣbaḥna) /is.tasˤ.baħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
# اُسْتُصْبِحْنَ (ustuṣbiḥna) /us.tusˤ.biħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
# اِسْتَصْبِحْنَ (istaṣbiḥna) /is.tasˤ.biħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
